findings.evidence: The exact-order section introduces `variable [CharZero R]` at line 199 before the theorems at lines 203, 219, and 237, whereas only the power-equals-one theorems at lines 140, 152, and 163 use the file-level `[CommRing R]` assumptions.
findings.fix: Qualify the exact-order claims and the later “arbitrary root pairing” summary with the characteristic-zero assumption, while distinguishing the arbitrary-commutative-ring iterate and upper-bound results.
findings.issue: The introduction says Cartan products `1`, `2`, `3` give exact orders `3`, `4`, `6` for an arbitrary root pairing, but exactness is only proved under `[CharZero R]`; over rings of positive characteristic the preceding results establish only divisibility.

summary: The module documentation overstates the generality of the exact-order results by omitting their characteristic-zero requirement.
